description: React component implementing a draft persona review and edit page for a web application. Includes UI for editing identity details, uploading avatar images, managing skills, experience highlights, and navigation to confirm and continue to skill validation.

classes.name: PlaceholderAvatarIcon
classes.description: SVG icon used as a placeholder avatar.

classes.name: CheckIcon
classes.description: SVG icon representing completion or checkmark.

classes.name: SkillChip
classes.description: Component displaying a skill as a tag with optional remove button.

classes.name: TextInput
classes.description: Reusable input component with label for text inputs.

classes.name: ExperienceCard
classes.description: Component displaying experience info with editing capability.

classes.name: WorkStyleInsight
classes.description: Component displaying a work style insight box.

classes.name: SuccessToast
classes.description: Component for displaying a transient success message.

classes.name: DraftPersonaPage
classes.description: Main React component rendering the persona review/edit page with multiple sections and actions.

methods.name: makeDefaultSkillsFromPersona
methods.description: Generates initial skill list from persona data.

methods.name: onPickAvatar
methods.description: Handles avatar image file selection, creates object URL, and updates state.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves current edits into persona state and persists via setDraftPersona.

methods.name: confirmAndContinue
methods.description: Finalizes persona data and routes to skill validation page.

methods.name: updateIdentity
methods.description: Updates professional identity fields in persona.

methods.name: updateHighlight
methods.description: Updates a specific experience highlight in persona.

methods.name: addSkill
methods.description: Adds a new skill to the skill list if not a duplicate.

methods.name: removeSkill
methods.description: Removes a skill from the skill list.
